shots.title: Add skill registry config, types, and .slope/skills.json persistence
shots.notes: Added the core skill registry schema, config defaults, persistence helpers, and exported API surface for repo-local skill metadata.

shots.title: Scan configured skill roots and parse SKILL.md plus agents/openai.yaml metadata

hazards.description: CodeQL flagged slug-normalization regexes as vulnerable to slow matching on hyphen-heavy skill names.

shots.notes: Implemented deterministic skill root scanning, YAML frontmatter parsing, agents/openai.yaml metadata capture, duplicate provider-root merging, registry validation, and linear-time skill id normalization.

shots.title: Add slope skills scan/list/validate commands and command registry docs

hazards.description: Self-review found that absolute --root and --output paths were being joined under cwd instead of preserved.

shots.notes: Added slope skills scan/list/validate, CLI dispatch, command registry metadata, smoke coverage, and absolute path regression coverage.

shots.title: Add scorecard skill fields and validate --skills reference checks

hazards.description: Self-review found malformed skill registry files could be loaded far enough to crash list/reference checks.

shots.notes: Added scorecard skill fields, builder support, structural validation, validate --skills reference checks, malformed registry rejection, and CLI regression coverage.

training.description: CLI path handling needs explicit absolute-path regression coverage.
training.outcome: Added absolute --root/--output coverage for slope skills scan and resolved explicit validate paths against cwd.

training.description: Regex-based normalization over repo metadata can trip CodeQL even when the input looks mundane.
training.outcome: Replaced skill id slug regexes with a linear scanner and added hyphen-heavy regression coverage.

nutrition.description: Validated targeted skill/scorecard tests, typecheck, build, built CLI smoke tests, and the full Vitest suite.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: This was a satisfying first layer: SLOPE can now see skills as metadata without pretending to run them.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Keep S114.5 deterministic. Use this registry as input to briefing recommendations before attempting smarter gap detection.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The useful review catches were plain path and malformed-file resilience, not the YAML parsing itself.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: Briefing can now recommend skills from a real registry instead of relying on tribal memory.

bunker_locations: Any CLI path flag that accepts user filesystem input should preserve absolute paths and resolve relative paths against cwd in tests.
Registry loaders should reject malformed top-level shapes before downstream code maps over arrays.
yardage_book_updates: Skill registry files live at config.skillsPath, defaulting to .slope/skills.json.
SLOPE indexes SKILL.md and optional agents/openai.yaml metadata but does not execute skills.
Skill id normalization should stay linear and avoid regex trimming over uncontrolled metadata.
Scorecard skill reference fields are skills_used, skills_created, skills_recommended, and skills_skipped; validate --skills checks these against the local registry.
skill_gaps_found is free-form and intentionally not registry-checked.
course_management_notes: Added src/core/skills.ts with scan, load/save, validation, duplicate merge, frontmatter parsing, and agents/openai.yaml metadata capture.
Added slope skills scan/list/validate and command registry metadata.
Added scorecard skill fields and validate --skills reference checking.
slope skills scan --root=.agents/skills, slope skills list, slope skills validate, and slope validate --skills smoke tests passed on the built CLI.
CodeQL high-severity regex alert was fixed with linear skill id normalization.
Full pnpm test passed: 214 test files and 3457 tests.
skill_gaps_found: SLOPE needed first-class skill registry and scorecard skill tracking before skill-aware briefing can be deterministic.
